name: ATM Cassette Counters 5
definition: Counters of media inside an ATM cassette.

AddedNumber.name: Added Number
AddedNumber.definition: Number of added media during servicing operations.

RemovedNumber.name: Removed Number
RemovedNumber.definition: Number of removed media during servicing operations.

RemovedAmount.name: Removed Amount
RemovedAmount.definition: Amount of removed media during servicing operations.

DispensedNumber.name: Dispensed Number
DispensedNumber.definition: Total number of media out of the cassette.

DepositedNumber.name: Deposited Number
DepositedNumber.definition: Total number of media deposited in the cassette.

DepositedAmount.name: Deposited Amount
DepositedAmount.definition: Amount of media deposited in the cassette.

RecycledNumber.name: Recycled Number
RecycledNumber.definition: Total number of recycled media from the cassette.

RetractedNumber.name: Retracted Number
RetractedNumber.definition: Total number of retracted media originating from the cassette.

RetractedAmount.name: Retracted Amount
RetractedAmount.definition: Total amount retracted during operation. Only intended to be used where each of the items in the cassette do not have the same value (for example for retracting checks).

RejectedNumber.name: Rejected Number
RejectedNumber.definition: Total number of media from this cassette which are on the reject bin.

PresentedNumber.name: Presented Number
PresentedNumber.definition: Total number of media presented to the customer.

InitialNumber.name: Initial Number
InitialNumber.definition: Initial number added during a servicing operation.

InitialAmount.name: Initial Amount
InitialAmount.definition: Initial amount added during a servicing operation.
